resources.string: Spoofs selected device properties and feature flags. Google Photos is the recommended LSPosed scope; extra apps are advanced and unsupported. Never scope Play Services, Play Store, system UI, or banking/payment apps.
When a lower Pixel profile is selected, ignore higher feature levels already supplied by the ROM. (Recommended)
The module is not active. Enable Pixelify Infinity in a compatible Xposed manager, keep Google Photos in scope (recommended), then reopen this app. Reboot if required by your Xposed manager.

Pixel XL enables Unlimited Original Quality Google Photos backup at no storage cost. If you prefer newer editing features (e.g. Magic Eraser, Ultra HDR), you can switch to a newer Pixel in the settings anytime.
Even though Pixel XL is already selected, Google Photos will not apply the spoofing until it is completely stopped and reopened. Tap the button below to apply changes immediately.
Force-stop scoped apps after changing settings to apply
Build fields: real vs spoof target
Values are read in this app process (the real device). Spoofing is applied only inside scoped apps such as Google Photos — the VERIFY result above reflects the hook process.

"No hook milestones recorded" usually means the module never loaded into Google Photos — check LSPosed enable + scope, then reboot. "Package loaded but never ready" points to a framework/API compatibility problem in your Xposed variant. A failed VERIFY means the module ran but could not write Build fields. Use "Copy diagnostics report" when reporting an issue — the report includes the module scope list and device Build values, but no account data.
No VERIFY record yet. Open Google Photos once, wait a few seconds, then reopen this screen.
